Subject: Redwood Private (VPC) - discovery recap & next steps

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Thanks again for taking the time today, good conversation. Quick recap from our side and proposed next steps so we stay aligned: 

- Current priority: reduce inference latency for customer-facing features and ensure data never leaves Acme Payments' VPC.
- Proposed solution: Redwood Private (VPC) deployment or Dedicated nodes behind a customer-managed VPC. Private gives you the on-prem/VPC control you mentioned; Dedicated can be faster to stand up if you can accept managed networking.
- Success criteria we heard: <48ms 95th token latency, SOC 2 evidence, and monthly cost target within your Q2 budget.

Next steps (proposed):
1) I'll share a brief pricing + deployment comparison and our SOC 2 report for your security team.
2) If helpful, set a 30-min follow-up with our Solutions Engineer to map network/firewall requirements and timeline.
3) Share a draft SOW and mutual action plan once we agree on deployment mode.

Can you confirm: (A) timeline (are you targeting Q2 prod?), and (B) who else on your side should be looped in for security/network?

Attachments: none in this message.

Thanks,

Hi Sarah / Tom,

Attaching the pricing comparison and our SOC 2 report as requested. High-level notes in the attachment:
- Hosted API: fastest to launch, lowest upfront, but data leaves your VPC. Good for low-sensitivity workloads.
- Dedicated: reserved GPU capacity for predictable throughput; can be placed in your cloud account with VPC peering, good midpoint for latency and control.
- Private (VPC / on-prem): full network isolation and customer-managed keys; best for regulated data but involves a longer setup and network checklist.

Attachment stubs: Redwood_VPC_Pricing.pdf; Redwood_SOC2_Report_2026.pdf; Draft_SOW_Acme.pdf

I can set a 30-min call with our Solutions Engineer (Jonas) to walk through firewall rules and the mutual action plan. Are you available next Tue 9 Feb or Wed 10 Feb (morning PT)?

Thanks,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
